title: OptimizationStudyViewV2
description: Authoritative P1-RT OptimizationStudyView (contract v2). Three independent authorities are never merged: product Requirements (requirement_report_id + product_requirements: did the design satisfy the customer?), optimization constraints (constraint_verdicts: SATISFIED|VIOLATED|UNMEASURABLE), and measured objectives (objective_values + objective_availability: MEASURED|UNMEASURABLE). Pareto input requires evaluation success, binding product requirements pass, every requested objective measured+finite, and every hard constraint SATISFIED, so pareto_member implies pareto_eligible. The v1 boolean-only projector is LOSSY by design and lives at contracts/srota/v1/optimization.study.view.schema.json.

optimization_result_id.description: Bare content_id digest of the OptimizationResult (re-derivable from definition_id + candidate rows + frontier).

definition.description: Lossless definition: identity, objective directions, constraint operators/thresholds, method and selection policy are all explicit.

domain.description: GUIDED knob ranges only. LOCKED dimensions are inexpressible here.

evaluation_ids.description: This candidate's evaluation provenance: design identity, authenticated performance result, and the product RequirementReport identity (null when no report exists).

product_requirements.description: PRODUCT authority: did the design satisfy the customer's requirements? null = no report exists (no product binding). Binding + UNMEASURABLE never passes.

objective_values.description: Measured, finite objective values only; absent metrics are never zero-filled.

objective_availability.description: Explicit state for every requested objective (plus any extra measured metric).

constraint_verdicts.description: OPTIMIZATION-CONSTRAINT authority: did the candidate satisfy the study's hard constraints? Three-state, never a boolean.

evaluation_authority.description: Structural fidelity of the evaluator that produced this row. Only certified-backend results can be Pareto-eligible; analytic-fake is a development double.

eligibility_reason.description: Typed explanation when pareto_eligible is false (evaluation status, authority, missing report/performance id, failed product requirements, unmeasured objectives, unsatisfied constraints). null when eligible.

pareto_eligible.description: Evaluation succeeded AND binding product requirements pass AND every requested objective measured+finite AND every hard constraint SATISFIED.
